sw_text_raw: UNCLE: It's because of COMPANIONS that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…$
UNCLE: Now hold on, LUKE.\pSince you started raising COMPANIONS,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge an ARENA?$
{PLAYER}, thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\pIt's not enough just to have\nCOMPANIONS and make them battle. That\lisn't what being a real TRAINER is\labout.$
You know, it's cool to have COMPANION\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your COMPANION gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.$
Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild COMPANIONS could jump you.$
MOS ESPA\n“Home of the BOONTA EVE CLASSIC!”$
MOS ESPA ARENA\nLEADER: WATTO\l“The junk dealer with a spark!”$
“Ride the dunes and shake up your\nsoul!”\lWALD'S BIKES$
Have you been to WALD'S BIKES yet?\pWALD, the owner, is a very generous\nman.$

Hi, do you check out the HoloNet
at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pThe HoloNet is so cool. I've seen my
friends on it just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on the HoloNet
sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out HoloNet screens whenever you can.$
Hi, have you been checking out the\nHoloNet?$
Well, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!\pMe? You may call me WALD.\nI'm the owner of this bike shop.$

WALD: Hm, hm… … … … …\pYou're saying that you came all this
way from MOS PELGO?\pMy goodness!
That's ridiculously far!\pIf you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the\lgentle caress of the wind!\pI'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!\pOh, wait a second!\pI forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!\pThey are the SWOOP BIKE and
the SPEEDER BIKE!\pThe SWOOP BIKE is for riders who want
to feel the wind in their faces!\pAnd a SPEEDER BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!\pI'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!\pWhich one will you choose?$

A BIKE moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.\pIt will speed up once it gets going.\pTo stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe BIKE will slow to a stop.\pWant to read a different page?$

There are small sandy slopes
all over the OUTER RIM.\pThe loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.\pBut if you have a SWOOP BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.\pWant to read a different page?$

Press the B Button while riding,\nand the nose of the bike lifts up.\pYou can zip around with the nose\nup using the + Control Pad.\pThis technique is called a wheelie.\pWant to read a different page?$
Were you looking for CHIPS?\pIt's 1000 credits for 50 CHIPS.\nWould you like some?$

Hey, how's it going, ILUM-
bound {PLAYER}?\pWATTO, the LEADER of MOS ESPA
ARENA, uses ELECTRIC-type COMPANIONS.\pIf you challenge him with WATER-type
COMPANIONS, he'll zap them! Bzzt!\pAnd, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his ARENA! Eccentric!\pHey, go for it!$
COMPANIONS and rock, it's all about\nheart, whoa-yeah!$
{PLAYER} traded the SPEEDER BIKE\nfor a SWOOP BIKE.$
{PLAYER} traded the SWOOP BIKE\nfor a SPEEDER BIKE.$
WATTO, our ARENA LEADER, has been\naround for a long, long time.\pHe was betting on podraces before\nyour daddy was born, that old coot.$
I've heard that WATTO has run his\njunk shop in MOS ESPA for ages.\pHe was a TRAINER long before we\nbecame TRAINERS.\lHe must know all sorts of things!$
MOS ESPA ARENA's WATTO has wings\nthat buzz so fast they hum.\lIt makes me happy!$

I've given up betting on podraces,
I have. That SKYWALKER boy cost me\leverything.\pAnd so, I put my time into making
door traps in my ARENA.\pOh? Now, what are you doing here?\pWhat's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?\pWahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!\pThen, I, WATTO, the LEADER of
MOS ESPA ARENA, shall electrify you!$
notes: Watto lost Anakin (and Shmi) on the Boonta Eve bet; canon nod

The ESPA GENERATOR is radiating heat\nthat can be felt even at a distance.\pIt looks like it should be turned off\nas soon as possible.$

I gave you?\pOh, I get it, you stored it using
your TERMINAL.\pWell, take it out of TERMINAL storage,

LUKE: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with AURALET,\nwe can beat anyone!$

LUKE: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?$
LUKE: Oh… If you won't battle me,\n{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've\lbecome really strong.$
UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?\nOn LUKE's behalf, can I ask you to\lbattle with him just this once?\pI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.$
LUKE: {PLAYER}, please!\nBattle with me, please.$
LUKE: {PLAYER}, thank you.\pOkay… Here I come!$
LUKE: UNCLE…\nI'll go back to ANCHORHEAD…$

UNCLE: LUKE, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\pWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\pCome on, let's go home.

UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\lan eye out for LUKE when he caught\lhis COMPANION.\pWhy don't you visit us in ANCHORHEAD\nsometime?\lI'm sure LUKE would enjoy it.$

LANDO: Hehe…
I was watching that match!\pYou're friends with that boy LUKE,
aren't you?\pBut you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.\pYeah! That's what a real COMPANION

I'll be cheering for you!$

I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMOS ESPA has an underground

switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into

WATTO: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to ESPA GENERATOR is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!$
WATTO: Wahahahaha!\pI knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\pThis is my thanks--a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\pGo on, you've earned it!$
WATTO: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!$
The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$
“The play spot for all!”\nMOS ESPA SABACC DEN$
WALD: Your RUNNING SHOES…\nThey're awfully filthy.\pDid you come from far away?$
WALD: Is that right?\pThen, I guess you have no need for\nany of my BIKES.$

WALD: Good, good!\nI'm happy that you like it!$

stop very quickly.\pIt gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.\pRelease the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.\pWant to read a different page?$

Pad at the same time to jump.\pPress the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.\pPress it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.\pWant to read a different page?$
